groups.title: Authentication
groups.description: All API requests require authentication using your Starshipit API key

endpoints.description: Send the starshipit-api-key header with requests to the WMS base URL. This wildcard entry describes authentication, not a callable endpoint. Missing authentication may return 400 or 401 depending on the route; an unresolved WMS account commonly returns 404. Response bodies are endpoint-specific. Permission-checked routes also resolve the authenticated user and enforce WMS role permissions and applicable client access. A valid account key does not guarantee permission for every operation. Job workflow actions use the authenticated worker; API keys do not inherit administrative recovery access from WMS web sessions.

groups.title: Jobs
groups.description: Retrieve warehouse workflow jobs and manage assignment, status, and priority updates

endpoints.description: Retrieve jobs with the common filters most useful for external integrations. Internal dashboard-specific query controls are intentionally omitted from this reference. With view omitted, PACK jobs include packReadyToShip and packProgress with packedQuantity, totalQuantity, percentage, activeProgressQuantity, savedPackedQuantity, fullyPackedQuantity, and source (none, active, saved, complete, or mixed). Quantities reflect the job’s allocated packing scope or saved shipment quantities. For single-order PACK jobs, orders[].order.tags is an array of trimmed, case-insensitively deduplicated tag strings; other jobs omit tags. Requires jobs.view permission. Results always include pagination, defaulting to page 1 and 50 jobs. The legacy paginate parameter does not disable pagination. Use view=summary for a compact list projection: listSummary contains whole-job order, SKU, allocation and replenishment counts and quantities, plus readyToShip; orderPreview, listSummary.skus, listSummary.replenishmentDestinations and replenishmentLinePreview each contain at most three entries. Summary rows omit the full orders, allocations and replenishmentLines collections. PACK summary rows also include packProgress. Use a job-detail endpoint for complete work details. Tags appear on orderPreview[].order.tags for single-order PACK summaries.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Match any supplied tag, case-insensitively, on single-order PACK jobs only. Repeat the parameter or separate names with commas. At most 50 names, each at most 100 characters.

endpoints.description: Update status, assignedUserId, and/or priority; send at least one supported field. Use dedicated pause and resume endpoints for PAUSED transitions. Status changes require jobs.complete and an authenticated worker; priority changes require jobs.assign. Direct PICK or PACK status updates also require jobs.assign; use picking or packing workflow endpoints for normal worker actions. Closing PICK or PACK jobs with status FAILED additionally requires fulfillment.manage and can return 207 with undoRelease results when some orders cannot be undone. For other job types, status updates enforce ownership unless the non-mobile caller has jobs.assign. An ownership-checked start of an unassigned non-SHIP job also requires jobs.claim and its workflow permission, and assigns the job to the authenticated worker. SHIP must already be claimed. Assignment changes require jobs.assign except supported self-assignment on start or clearing assignment with a status change. Mobile requests can release their own assignment with assignedUserId:null and jobs.release, but cannot combine that release with status. performedBy cannot replace the authenticated worker for status changes.

endpoints.description: Retrieve warehouse locations with optional helper filters, text search across names, barcodes, and zone names, pagination, compact responses, and occupancy data for replenishment planning. Full location records include priority, the bulk replenishment source preference (0–10). Requires locations.view permission. Setting includeOccupancy=true or supplying replenishmentProductId also requires inventory.view permission.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Helper filter or `LocationType` enum value. Supported helper filters are `receivable`, `available-tote`, `equipment`, `tote`, `packing-bench`, `putaway-target`, and `advisory-putaway-target`. `putaway-target` returns BULK_STORAGE and PICK_FACE. `advisory-putaway-target` also includes QUARANTINE and RETURNS_DAMAGED for advisory putaway destinations.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive location name, barcode, or zone-name search.

parameters.name: equipmentLocationId
parameters.description: Limit `tote` or `available-tote` results to totes attached to a specific equipment location.

parameters.name: compact
parameters.description: true returns location summaries: id, name, barcode, type, zoneId, zone (id and name), parentLocationId, sequence, minCapacity, maxCapacity, allowMixedClientStock, isDefaultStocktake, and visible. Omits full allowed-product relationships and priority.

parameters.name: includeOccupancy
parameters.description: When `true`, append `occupiedProductIds`, `totalQuantityOnHand`, and `openReplenishmentQuantityByProductId` to each location.

parameters.name: isDefaultStocktake
parameters.description: When supplied, return only locations whose default-stocktake setting matches `true` or `false`.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Filter by archive state. Defaults to `active`; use `archived` for archived locations or `all` for both active and archived locations.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. Provide with `limit` for paginated results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows per page. Must be between 1 and 100.

parameters.name: exactBarcode
parameters.description: Exact case-insensitive barcode match. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed; blank values are ignored. Combines with other filters.

parameters.name: exactName
parameters.description: Exact case-insensitive location name match. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed; blank values are ignored. Combines with other filters.

parameters.name: zoneId
parameters.description: Filter by zone ID. Use none for locations with no zone.

parameters.name: nameRange
parameters.description: Filter by the first letter of the location name, ignoring case. Use a-m for A–M or n-z for N–Z. Other values return 400.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort field. Must be supplied with sortDirection. allowedSkus sorts by the number of allowed products. Paginated name sorting uses natural numeric order (for example, A2 before A10).

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort direction. Must be supplied with sortBy.

parameters.name: includeInvisible
parameters.description: true includes invisible locations and uses all archive states when archived is omitted. An explicit archived filter takes precedence.

parameters.name: revalidate
parameters.description: true bypasses the cached location read.

endpoints.description: Create a manual stock adjustment or an internal location transfer for products in the authenticated WMS account. To request final-stock decisions on transfers, send productLocationDecisionCapability: "final-stock-v1". A transfer removing the final units from a pick face with minimum capacity configured can then return 409 PRODUCT_LOCATION_DECISION_REQUIRED, whether or not the product has an Allowed SKU assignment. A stale decision returns 409 PRODUCT_LOCATION_DECISION_STALE; refresh inventory and location configuration before deciding again. endpoints.description: Retrieve outstanding purchase-order stock grouped by product and purchase order. Includes DRAFT, CREATED, ORDERED, IN_TRANSIT, ARRIVED and PARTIALLY_RECEIVED purchase orders with a positive outstanding quantity; RECEIVED orders are excluded.
